ISO 19650 for BIM Delivery Teams

ISO 19650 can read as a framework for managers. This is what it changes for the people producing and checking models every day.

ISO 19650 is the international standard series for managing information over the life of a built asset using BIM. It is often discussed at strategy level. For delivery teams, its value is practical: everyone knows what information is needed, where it lives and when it can be relied on.

Information requirements come first

The appointing party sets out what information it needs (organisational, asset, project and exchange information requirements). Delivery teams respond with a BIM Execution Plan and plan what each task team will deliver and when. For modelers this means the LOD and the data on each element are defined in advance, not guessed.

The common data environment

All information is shared through a CDE with defined states. In practice:

  • Work in progress stays within your task team.
  • Shared information is checked and made available to other teams for coordination.
  • Published information is authorised for use, for example for construction.
  • Archived keeps the record of what was issued.

Naming and status codes

Containers (files and models) follow an agreed naming convention with fields such as project, originator, volume, level, type, role and number. Status codes show what a container can be used for. Consistent naming is the easiest win and the most common failure.

Checking before sharing

Information is checked before it moves from work in progress to shared. A model QA checklist built from the BEP turns this into a routine rather than an occasional audit.

What delivery teams should do

  1. Read the BEP and the delivery plan for your task, not just the template.
  2. Use the naming and status rules every time.
  3. Check your own model against the checklist before sharing.
  4. Raise missing or conflicting requirements early.

National annexes and project requirements add local detail, so always work to the documents issued for your project. ENGISOFT supports teams with BIM execution planning, BIM management and model audits.
